chunks: Al-Musawi said: Narrated to me Ali ibn Khalaf al-Anmati, who said: Narrated to us Abdullah ibn Wazzah from Yazid al-Saigh

He said: When Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) was given birth to Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), I made for him gold ornaments (awdah) and gifted them to him. When I brought the gift to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), he said to me: O Yazid, you have gifted it, by Allah, to the Qaim of the Family of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family).

key_terms.قَائِمُ: The Rising One / The Awaited Imam

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the gift given to him on the occasion of Imam Musa al-Kadhim's birth?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Shaykh al-Tusi highlights the divine designation (*nass*) of Imam Musa al-Kadhim (a.s) as the future Qaim, linking the birth of the sixth Imam to the eschatological leader. The gift of 'awdah' (ornaments) symbolizes the honor bestowed upon the Imamate, while the Imam’s specific attribution to the 'Qaim of the Family of Muhammad' underscores the continuity of leadership and the unique status of the Ahl al-Bayt in Shia theology.
